implementation.targetScope: React 19.3 useTranslation, initialization plugin, provider/context, subscription settings and resource loading/Suspense contract. Trans, HOCs, SSR state injection, rich-text HTML parsing and resource-schema inference are not included.

changes: Independently written hook/provider runtime with no HTML parser or copied upstream implementation.
Stable useSyncExternalStore snapshots preserve translators across unrelated parent updates; subscriptions are released on unmount or engine/options change.
Pending namespace loads are shared across concurrent Suspense retries, without caching translation results or hiding resource changes.
SSR request providers isolate engines; translation text uses React's normal escaping.

caller.scope: 160 useTranslation imports, one initialization-plugin import and four provider imports in application src. No Trans, Translation, withTranslation or useSSR imports. Current adapter 18.0.1 and app adapter 15.4.1 are controls with current/app/VPM engines.
